description: Use this to stand up a client, one website (project), and its forms in a single call. Before calling, ask the human who should receive notification emails (notify_emails has no default; empty means nobody is emailed), thank-you page vs on-page message, and whether to add Turnstile — see furrow://docs/workflow. name/slug are the client; optional project_name/project_slug default to the same. Free accounts cannot create a fourth active project — call create_upgrade_link if bootstrap_site returns plan_limit. Operator tokens (all workspaces) must pass team_id from list_teams. Team-scoped tokens may omit team_id and cannot target another workspace. Idempotent on client, project, and form slugs. Site settings (domains, Turnstile, notify emails, webhook, email templates, uploads) live on the project. Email templates support {{project.name}}, {{project.slug}}, {{form.name}}, {{form.slug}}, {{count}} (1-based clean submissions on this form, including the current one), and any submission field such as {{name}} or {{email}}. Use a fallback with {{name | "New submission"}}. Missing fields render empty and never error. Do not pass HTML; Furrow renders one owned layout. Plans are capacity, not a feature ladder. Free: one workspace, 100 clean submissions/month pooled on the team, 3 active (non-archived) projects, 30-day submission retention, and email.footer_mode / branding.mode stay furrow (other values return plan_limit). Yearly ($199/year): extra workspaces, 10,000 submissions/month, unlimited projects, 730-day retention, branding.mode furrow | off | agency. Expansion packs are $99/year each and add 5,000 submissions/month on a yearly account. MCP, webhooks, snippets, inheritance, Turnstile, and email templates stay available on free. Spam, honeypot, and rejected posts do not count. Use create_upgrade_link to hand a human a Stripe Checkout (or Customer Portal) URL. Pass product=expansion on a yearly team to add a pack. Checkbox groups, select multiple, and other multi-value HTML fields must use a [] suffix on the name (name="services[]") or only the last checked value is stored. Put services[] on field_contract.name too. JSON/fetch should send a real array without brackets ({ "services": ["a", "b"] }) and must not use Object.fromEntries(formData) — use formData.getAll("services"). Single checkbox, select, or combobox: no brackets. File inputs use multipart POST (name="resume[]" for multiple). Enable uploads on the project first. Downloads are the project inbox at files_url, with the form slug as a folder — never put that URL in a public snippet. Do not use when you only need to patch an existing form — call update_form.

allowed_domains.description: Hostnames allowed to post to this project's forms (example.com, www.example.com). Empty accepts any origin.

default_redirect_url.description: Where classic HTML posts redirect after success. Null returns JSON/inline success instead.

email.description: Notification email template for the project: subject, from_name, intro, footer_mode, include_meta.

footer_mode.description: furrow shows the Furrow footer, minimal shows a one-line footer, off hides it (yearly plans only).

from_name.description: Display name on the From line of notification emails.

include_meta.description: Include submission metadata (IP, user agent, referrer, timestamp) below the fields.

intro.description: Plain-text paragraph above the submitted fields. Supports {{tokens}}. Null removes it.

subject.description: Notification email subject. Supports {{tokens}} such as {{form.name}} or {{name}}.

forms.description: Forms to create or update on the site, matched by slug. Re-running is safe.

email.description: Per-form subject and intro overrides for the notification email.

intro.description: Per-form intro override. Supports {{tokens}}. Null falls back to the project intro.

subject.description: Per-form subject override. Supports {{tokens}}. Null falls back to the project subject.

label.description: Human label used in the snippet and notification email. Defaults to the field name.

name.description: Posted field name. HTML checkbox groups / multi-select must end in [] (services[]) or only the last value is stored. JSON arrays omit the brackets.

report.description: Include this field in dashboard summaries and reports.

required.description: Emit the HTML required attribute in get_snippet so the browser blocks an empty submit. Set it on the fields a lead is useless without, usually email and message.

type.description: text, email, textarea, file, etc. type=file emits a file input in get_snippet.

field_contract.description: Declared fields (name, type, label, report). Drives get_snippet and the email layout. Null clears it.

fields.description: Shorthand for field_contract: the fields this form posts.

label.description: Human label used in the snippet and notification email. Defaults to the field name.

name.description: Posted field name. HTML checkbox groups / multi-select must end in [] (services[]) or only the last value is stored. JSON arrays omit the brackets.

report.description: Include this field in dashboard summaries and reports.

required.description: Emit the HTML required attribute in get_snippet so the browser blocks an empty submit. Set it on the fields a lead is useless without, usually email and message.

type.description: text, email, textarea, file, etc. type=file emits a file input in get_snippet.

name.description: Form display name, e.g. Contact or Quote request.

notify_bcc_override.description: Bcc for this form only. Empty array sends no Bcc. Null inherits the project's notify_bcc.

notify_cc_override.description: Cc for this form only. Empty array sends no Cc. Null inherits the project's notify_cc.

notify_emails_override.description: Recipients for this form only. Null inherits the project's notify_emails.

notify_phones_override.description: Text-alert numbers for this form only (E.164). Empty array silences texts for this form. Null inherits the project's notify_phones. Text messages need the team's own Twilio account first (update_account sms).

redirect_url_override.description: Success redirect for this form only. Null inherits default_redirect_url.

require_turnstile_override.description: Force Turnstile on or off for this form. Null inherits the project setting.

slug.description: Lowercase hyphenated identifier, unique per project. Used for idempotent re-runs.

webhook_secret_override.description: HMAC secret for this form's webhook. Null inherits the project secret.

webhook_url_override.description: Webhook endpoint for this form only. Null inherits the project webhook.

from_name.description: Legacy From display name. Prefer email.from_name.

honeypot_field.description: Name of the hidden honeypot input the snippet emits. Defaults to _gotcha.

notify_bcc.description: Bcc'd on every notification email (max 10), hidden from the other recipients — use it when an agency wants a silent copy of a client's leads. Copies only: an email still needs at least one notify_emails address, and an address on more than one list is sent once (To, then Cc, then Bcc). Copies get [Potential spam] emails too.

notify_cc.description: Cc'd on every notification email (max 10). Copies only: an email still needs at least one notify_emails address, and an address on more than one list is sent once (To, then Cc, then Bcc). Copies get [Potential spam] emails too.

notify_emails.description: Addresses that receive each clean submission (max 10). Inherited by every form. Required unless webhook_url is set — ask the human which inbox should get submissions.

notify_phones.description: E.164 numbers that get a short "new lead, check your email" text per clean submission (max 5). Inherited by every form. Never sent for spam. Text messages need the team's own Twilio account first (update_account sms).

project_name.description: Website display name. Defaults to the client name.

project_slug.description: Website slug. Defaults to the client slug.

rate_limit_per_ip.description: Max submissions per IP within rate_limit_window_s.

require_turnstile.description: Reject submissions that lack a valid Turnstile token.

slug.description: Lowercase hyphenated identifier, unique per team. Used for idempotent re-runs.

team_id.description: Team id from list_teams. Required for operator tokens and OAuth logins; team-scoped frw_ tokens may omit it.

turnstile_secret.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret used to verify tokens server-side. Null removes it.

turnstile_site_key.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key for the frontend widget. Null removes it.

upload_allowed_types.description: Allowed upload MIME types, e.g. application/pdf or image/*.

upload_max_file_bytes.description: Max bytes per file (up to 25 MB).

upload_max_total_bytes.description: Max total upload bytes per submission (up to 50 MB).

uploads_enabled.description: Accept multipart file fields on this project's forms.

webhook_secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret for the X-Furrow-Signature header. Omit to have one generated and returned.

webhook_url.description: Public https endpoint that receives a signed JSON POST per clean submission. Null disables it.
